events.title: Siemens Links $1b U.S. Buildout With Smart Grid Cybersecurity Growth
events.body: Siemens has reached a cumulative $1b in U.S. manufacturing investments over the past five years. The company reports that these investments support American industry, infrastructure, transportation, and jobs, while expanding domestic supply

events.title: Siemens USA CEO talks milestone $1B investment to US manufacturing
events.body: Siemens USA (SIEGY) reached $1 billion in US manufacturing investments over the past five years, which will support many domestic industrial and infrastructure projects. Siemens USA CEO and president Ann Fairchild comes on Market Catalysts
